headline: Kuura Strand Erupts in Sudden Fighting Amid Bitter Clashes Across Weathered Expanse
war_summary: Since midday reports, the northern front has shifted dramatically as Kuura Strand exploded into intense combat, seeing fifteen base transitions within two hours across Martti and Menneen to leave Colonials clinging to a solitary position against five Warden holds. In the Weathered Expanse, the bitter attrition has reduced four contested bases to unheld ruins, stripping the Wardens of their last foothold and leaving Colonials holding five strongholds under unrelenting bombardment that claimed three thousand casualties in two hours. Along the Nevish Line, fighting remains brisk around Grief Mother and Blackcoat Way with five recent base exchanges, maintaining a five-to-three Warden advantage despite cooling casualty rates. Further south, Fishermans Row saw sharp naval and island action unfold across Oceanwatch and Peripti Landing, awarding the Wardens a single toehold alongside one neutral ruin and seven Colonial bastions. Meanwhile, Wardens established a second strongpoint on the Stlican Shelf alongside seven Colonial redoubts, even as Callahan's Passage fell quiet on territorial changes despite relentless localized bloodletting.
